description: This file contains data access functions for the backend part of a project, specifically implementing CRUD operations and list retrievals for user, team, board, sprint, and task models using SQLModel and SQLAlchemy sessions.

methods.name: Optional[ModelT] _get_or_none(session: Session, model: Type[ModelT], obj_id: int)
methods.description: Helper function that retrieves an object by ID or returns None if not found.

methods.name: User create_user(session: Session, email: str, password: str, full_name: Optional[str] = None, is_active: bool = True)
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password and adds it to the session.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_email(session: Session, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user record based on email.

methods.name: List[User] list_users(session: Session, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0)
Optional[User] update_user_password(session: Session, user_id: int, new_password: str)
methods.description: Updates a user's password with a new hashed password.

methods.name: Team create_team(session: Session, name: str, description: Optional[str] = None, owner_id: Optional[int] = None)
List[Team] list_teams(session: Session, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0)
Board create_board(session: Session, team_id: int, name: str, description: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new board record under a specified team.

methods.name: List[Board] list_boards_by_team(session: Session, team_id: int, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Lists all boards belonging to a specific team.

methods.name: Sprint create_sprint(session: Session, board_id: int, name: str, goal: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new sprint within a specified board.

methods.name: List[Sprint] list_sprints_by_board(session: Session, board_id: int, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Lists sprints associated with a specific board.

methods.name: Task create_task( session: Session, board_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str] = None, status: str = "todo", sprint_id: Optional[int] = None, assignee_id: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a new task under a board, with optional associations to sprint and assignee.

methods.name: List[Task] list_tasks_by_board(session: Session, board_id: int, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Lists tasks belonging to a specific board.

methods.name: Optional[Task] update_task_status(session: Session, task_id: int, status: str)
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified task.
